addons.name: Alterra Kitchen
addons.description: Fruit juices in their own glasses (and as fluids), a fruit press, fruit crates and a grape trellis.
addons.author: Phalynxi

addons.name: Alterra Weather
addons.description: Storms with a life of their own: sandstorms, blizzards, fog banks, petal storms, pollen, ashfall and an aurora, with wind.
addons.author: Phalynxi

addons.name: Alterra Music
addons.description: Original background music for Alterra's biomes: tracks for cold, temperate, warm and dry lands, the seas, caves and the sky.
addons.author: Phalynxi

addons.name: Alterra for Farmer's Delight
addons.description: Crystal, Ember and Frost knives, and cooking pot and cutting board recipes for Alterra's logs, flowers and juices.
addons.author: Phalynxi

addons.name: Alterra for Create
addons.description: Create recipes: millstone and crushing for flowers, cacti and crystals, the saw for logs, Astral Water, and juice pressing, mixing and bottling.
addons.author: Phalynxi

addons.name: Alterra for Create Aeronautics
addons.description: Alterra's clouds are almost weightless and lift an airship like levitite does.
addons.author: Phalynxi
